purpose: Durable repo-level reference for CIRS Dashboard orchestration, specialist handoffs, and contract-alignment updates.

whenToUpdate: When durable dashboard workflow, contract-alignment, or rollout priorities change.
When specialist output introduces reusable constraints, validation defaults, or handoff notes.
When agent instructions would otherwise need duplicate durable updates across multiple files.
doNotStore: Secrets, tokens, credentials, or personal data.
One-off chat recap without future planning value.

include: handoff notes another agent should inherit

stableFocus: Keep the dashboard aligned with the API contract, roles, and dynamic CRUD configuration.
Preserve capability-aware navigation, protected route patterns, and centralized API client usage.
Prefer dynamic CRUD for standard resources and custom feature modules for richer operational workflows.
Stay Tuguegarao-first and avoid UI assumptions looser than backend authorization.

currentReference.crossRepoBoundary: Return backend or mobile follow-up as coordination notes for xypes-platform-orchestrator instead of implementing cross-repo from the dashboard repo.

coordinationNotes: The API repo remains the source of truth for contracts, roles, rate limits, and privacy boundaries.
Treat dashboard-crud-config.flat.json drift as a real bug and keep config, typed clients, and permission checks aligned.
Hide or disable privileged UI consistently, but do not treat UI visibility as a substitute for backend enforcement.
validationDefaults: Prefer targeted Vitest coverage for touched pages, hooks, and feature modules.
Use the narrowest useful contract or type validation for changed API integration slices.
Use git diff --check when customization changes have no narrower executable validation.

workingState.activeArea: Shared agent-context adoption for orchestrators and specialists.
notes: Treat this file as the canonical durable reference instead of duplicating updateable state across multiple agent files.
